subject.title: Backup: add encrypted snapshot backup flow

question: Should OpenClaw accept this native folder-backed encrypted snapshot and workspace-mirroring backup flow in core, including backup.target/encryption config and setup/run/list/restore commands, once the safety findings and proof gap are resolved?
rationale: This is a new core backup/storage/security surface rather than a narrow bug fix, and repository policy treats config, destructive restore, and persisted-state behavior as compatibility-sensitive product decisions.

options.title: Sponsor after repair
options.body: Proceed with the core feature only after the safety fixes, upgrade proof, and real behavior proof are present.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Keep local archive export/restore in core and defer folder-backed snapshots or workspace mirroring to a smaller follow-up design.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Close or pause this branch if maintainers do not want native backup expansion in core right now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after repair
recommendation.body: Proceed with the core feature only after the safety fixes, upgrade proof, and real behavior proof are present.

likelyOwner.reason: CONTRIBUTING.md identifies steipete as the project decision owner, and the decision is broader than a single CLI file owner.
